'''Kerilt''' was the innermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Algaran system]],<ref name="PoG2" /> covered by large rainforests. Many surviving [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] fled to Kerilt after the bombardment of [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], founding the planet's first [[City/Legends|city]], [[Morymento]].<ref name="I,J" />

The planet was [[Battle of Algara|plundered]] by the [[Invids]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], although they left supplies for the colony to grow.<ref name="I,J" />

From Kerilt, the Caamasi later relocated to [[Susevfi]].
